text:
jamie: Heads-up — we're rolling out the new unified fallback policy this week. Canaries start Tue 2026-03-24 00:00 UTC (overnight window). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unified-fallback-policy :rotating_light:

ana: @jamie noted. I'm oncall that night and can stay in channel for the first 2 hours. Any hard cutoff for rollback?

jamie: no hard cutoff — plan is: 1) enable policy for 5% of traffic, 2) run traffic-sim for 30m against canary pool, 3) evaluate SLO burn & error budget, 4) scale to 25% then 100% if green. Rollback if p99 latency > 200ms or error rate spike > 0.5%.

olivia: quick product question — customer-facing behavior change?

jamie: short answer: no change to API surface. Internals: when capacity is constrained we will route to quantized-small model variants before doing region-level fallbacks. That may increase tail latency slightly but avoids large-scale errors.

matt: FYI please update the alert thresholds before canary: set infra/p99-latency to 140ms (was 120ms) for best-effort tier and keep premium at 120ms. I'll push the PR to monitoring in ~30m.

kofi: link to monitoring PR?

matt: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/982 — description: "slo: adjust p99 for unified-fallback canary". reviewers: @olivia, @ana.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: traffic-sim-canary-20260324 at 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z. CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/5621

ana: thanks — I'll watch graphs and be ready to trigger rollback. Notifying pager duty 10m before start.

jamie: small ops notes:
- prep: warm KV cache prefixes for canary pool (run: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --pool=canary`)
- traffic sim: `tools/traffic-sim --target canary --rps 1200 --duration 1800`
- abort signal: post `!abort-unified-fallback` in this thread and @oncall will run rollback playbook

olivia: do we need CS or account execs notified?

jamie: only if we hit rollback conditions. I'll ping CS if we detect >0.2% 5xx sustained for 10m.

matt: minor thing — add a temporary canary label so observability dashboards filter correctly: `canary=unified-fallback-v1`

kofi: copied runbook to my laptop for offline access. :thumbsup:

ana: oncall checklist done. I will start channel watch at 23:45 UTC and hang around until 02:00 UTC.

jamie: thanks all. Posting a quick preflight note in #incidents 1h before start and will follow up with a short postmortem doc in /docs/ops/canaries/unified-fallback if anything unexpected happens. :white_check_mark:
